components.css: :root{--s0:#0b0b0d;--s1:#121215;--s2:#18191d;--s3:#212227;--s4:#2b2c33;--linie:#24252b;--linie-stark:#34353d;--t1:#f3f4f6;--t2:#c3c7cd;--t3:#8b9099;--t4:#62666f;--primaer:#fff;--primaer-hover:#e4e6ea;--auf-primaer:#0b0b0d;--fehler:#f0525a;--fehler-flaeche:#2a1416;--warnung:#e2b34a;--warnung-flaeche:#29220f;--live:#5ad08b;--r-s:6px;--r:8px;--r-l:12px;--ein:cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)}.ds-schalter{position:relative;display:inline-block;width:40px;height:22px}.ds-schalter input{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:0;opacity:0}.ds-schalter span{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:11px;background:var(--s0);border:1px solid #4a4b54;transition:background-color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease}.ds-schalter span::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--t2);transition:transform 180ms var(--ein),background-color 160ms ease}.ds-schalter input:checked+span{background:var(--primaer);border-color:var(--primaer)}.ds-schalter input:checked+span::after{transform:translateX(18px);background:var(--auf-primaer)}.ds-schalter input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--t1);outline-offset:2px}

components.css: :root{--s0:#0b0b0d;--s1:#121215;--s2:#18191d;--s3:#212227;--s4:#2b2c33;--linie:#24252b;--linie-stark:#34353d;--t1:#f3f4f6;--t2:#c3c7cd;--t3:#8b9099;--t4:#62666f;--primaer:#fff;--primaer-hover:#e4e6ea;--auf-primaer:#0b0b0d;--fehler:#f0525a;--fehler-flaeche:#2a1416;--warnung:#e2b34a;--warnung-flaeche:#29220f;--live:#5ad08b;--r-s:6px;--r:8px;--r-l:12px;--ein:cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)}.ds-tab{font-family:Archivo,'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;border-radius:var(--r-l);background:var(--s1);color:var(--t1);font-size:14px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;max-width:560px;overflow:clip}.ds-z{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr 40px 112px;align-items:center;gap:16px;min-height:48px;padding:0 12px 0 18px;transition:background-color 100ms ease}.ds-z:hover{background:var(--s2)}.ds-z strong{font-size:15px}.ds-spur{display:block;height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--s3);overflow:hidden}.ds-spur i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--t2);transform-origin:left center}.ds-sig{display:inline-flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px;height:12px}.ds-sig i{width:3px;border-radius:1px;background:var(--s4)}.ds-sig i:nth-child(1){height:5px}.ds-sig i:nth-child(2){height:8px}.ds-sig i:nth-child(3){height:12px}.ds-sig i.an{background:var(--t1)}.ds-join{font-family:Archivo,'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;height:28px;padding:0 10px;border:0;border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--s3);color:var(--t1);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;justify-self:end;min-width:96px;transition:background-color 120ms ease}.ds-z:hover .ds-join{background:var(--primaer);color:var(--auf-primaer)}.ds-z:hover .ds-join:hover{background:var(--primaer-hover)}.ds-join:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--t1);outline-offset:2px}

components.css: :root{--s0:#0b0b0d;--s1:#121215;--s2:#18191d;--s3:#212227;--s4:#2b2c33;--linie:#24252b;--linie-stark:#34353d;--t1:#f3f4f6;--t2:#c3c7cd;--t3:#8b9099;--t4:#62666f;--primaer:#fff;--primaer-hover:#e4e6ea;--auf-primaer:#0b0b0d;--fehler:#f0525a;--fehler-flaeche:#2a1416;--warnung:#e2b34a;--warnung-flaeche:#29220f;--live:#5ad08b;--r-s:6px;--r:8px;--r-l:12px;--ein:cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)}.ds-rail{font-family:Archivo,'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;width:232px;padding:18px 12px;background:var(--s1);border-right:1px solid var(--linie)}.ds-ein{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;height:38px;padding:0 10px;border:0;border-radius:var(--r);background:transparent;color:var(--t2);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;text-align:left;transition:background-color 120ms ease,color 120ms ease}.ds-ein:hover{background:var(--s2);color:var(--t1)}.ds-ein.aktiv{background:var(--s3);color:var(--t1);font-weight:600}.ds-ein.aktiv::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-12px;top:10px;bottom:10px;width:3px;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;background:var(--t1)}.ds-ein:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--t1);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
The mark is a plain code sign, `</>`: silver chevrons and a white slash on a black rounded tile. It says "tool for people who tinker" at a glance. The identity is achromatic and flat: neutrals only, no hue, no gradients, glow or shadow. It is pure vector and scales cleanly to any size.

The launcher UI keeps the category's proven layout without irony: a navigation rail on the left, a game page with one big play button, settings in grouped cards with switches, a status dock at the bottom. It sits at the level of Windows 11 Settings, Discord and Steam, built from the four logo neutrals stretched into a short ladder of greys. Hierarchy comes from surface brightness, never from shadow or gradient. The page is dense, quiet and dark, so the white primary button and the few signal colours carry all the emphasis.
keyCharacteristics: Flat black ground (#0B0B0D) with four tonal steps above it.
One white primary with black text per view; everything else is grey.
Signal colours appear only where they carry meaning: online, warning, error.
One family, Archivo, self-hosted; headings slightly wide, body at normal width.
Short, transform-only motion that respects reduced motion.

rules.name: The Four Neutrals Rule
rules.body: The identity uses black, gray, silver and white only. Fills are flat. No gradients, glow or shadow.

rules.name: The Black Ground Rule
rules.body: The two-tone mark (silver plus white) sits only on black, inside the tile or on a black ground. On light grounds, use the single-ink black mark.

rules.name: The Outlined Wordmark Rule
rules.body: The wordmark ships as outlines. Never retype it in a live font, uppercase it, or change its tracking.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Signal Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only where a state needs them: green for online or playing, amber for experimental or warning, red for errors. Never as decoration, accent or brand colour.

rules.name: The Brightness Ladder Rule
rules.body: Depth is one step up the surface ladder (s0 → s1 → s2 → s3 → s4). A hovered or raised element moves one step brighter; it does not gain a shadow.

rules.name: The Tabular Data Rule
rules.body: Numbers that sit in lists or change live use tabular numerals, so columns do not jitter.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Identifiers Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks machine identifiers only: server IDs, flag names, setting keys, file paths. Never for headings, labels or prose.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces do not cast shadows. Separation comes from a brighter surface step or a hairline.

rules.name: The Floating-Layer Exception
rules.body: Only layers that float above the page carry one soft drop shadow: the search suggestions (`0 12px 28px #00000073`) and the update dialog (`0 24px 64px -12px #000c`, over a Black scrim at 80 %). Anything that sits in the page flow stays flat.

dos: **Do** keep the slash white and the chevrons silver on the two-tone mark.
**Do** use the black mark on light grounds.
**Do** use one white primary button per view; every other action is default or flach.
**Do** step one surface brighter for hover and raised states (s1 → s2 → s3 → s4).
**Do** use Live Green only for online or playing, Warning Amber only for experimental or warning, Error Red only for errors.
**Do** set counts, pings and times in tabular numerals, and identifiers (server IDs, flag names, keys, paths) in mono.
**Do** animate only `transform` and `opacity`, 120–250 ms on the enter curve, and grow bars with `scaleX`.
**Do** write UI copy in German, du form, short active sentences, with correct umlauts and no dashes as a stylistic device.
**Do** give every empty or failed list a notice that says what happened and what to do.
**Do** make a whole row the click target (player rows, friends, account) and let a chevron or hover step show it.
donts: **Don't** imitate Roblox's logo, or use "Roblox" or "Blox" in any name.
**Don't** add colour, gradients or glow, and no shadow outside floating layers.
**Don't** tilt the mark or change its stroke weight.
**Don't** use glass, blur, Mica or neon effects.
**Don't** animate width, height or layout; the rail switches between two fixed widths.
**Don't** use signal colours as decoration or to make a screen livelier.
